mask as specified by the bitfield.\n592.      * Uses space as a separator to determine which fragments to hide.\n593.      */\n594.     private static class MaskOutputStream extends FilterOutputStream {\n595.         private static final String MASK_STRING = \"********\";\n596. \n597.         private final boolean[] masks;\n598.         private final static char SEPARATOR = ' ';\n599.         private int index;\n600.         private boolean wrote;\n601. \n602. \n603.         public MaskOutputStream(OutputStream out, boolean[] masks) {\n604.             super(out);\n605.             this.masks = masks;\n606.         }\n607. \n608.         @Override\n609.         public void write(int b) throws IOException {\n610.             if (masks == null || index >= masks.length) {\n611.                 out.write(b);\n612.             } else if (isSeparator(b)) {\n613.                 out.write(b);\n614.                 index++;\n615.                 wrote = false;\n616.             } else if (masks[index]) {\n617.                 if (!wrote) {\n618.                     wrote = true;\n619.                     for (char c : MASK_STRING.toCharArray()) {\n620.                         out.write(c);\n621.                     }\n622.                 }\n623.             } else {\n624.                 out.write(b);\n625.             }\n626.         }\n627. \n628.         private boolean isSeparator(int b) {\n629.             return b == SEPARATOR;\n630.         }\n631.     }\n632. \n633.     private static void doExec(PrintStream in, boolean windows, PrintStream out, boolean[] masks, String... statements) {\n634.         long start = System.nanoTime();\n635.         // For logging\n636.         ByteArrayOutputStream loggingOutput = new ByteArrayOutputStream();\n637.         // Tee both outputs\n638.         TeeOutputStream teeOutput = new TeeOutputStream(out, loggingOutput);\n639.         // Mask sensitive output\n640.         MaskOutputStream maskedOutput = new MaskOutputStream(teeOutput, masks);\n641.         // Tee everything together\n642.         PrintStream tee = null;\n643.         try {\n644.
